reasoning___DocumentTitle: Caption is centered and bolded at the top of page 1: "MORTGAGE". No modifier ("Amended", "Consolidated") appears anywhere in the heading block, so the title is taken verbatim.
reasoning___BeneficiaryName: The granting clause on page 1 reads "...unto Sunstate Federal Savings Bank, its successors and assigns". The signature block on page 7 names "Sunstate Federal Savings" without "Bank"; I kept the longer form from the operative clause, which controls.
reasoning___CondominiumName: Exhibit A describes the collateral as "Unit 12-B" and references a Declaration of Condominium recorded at Book 21883, Page 441, but never names the regime. The letterhead mentions "Bayfront Tower" — that is the seller's marketing name, not a recorded condominium name, so I left the field null rather than guess.
reasoning___DatedDate: Preamble: "THIS MORTGAGE is made this 23rd day of June, 2017". The notary jurat on page 7 is dated June 26, 2017 — that is the acknowledgment date and was not used.
reasoning___PrincipalAmount: The note recital states "FOUR HUNDRED EIGHTY-SIX THOUSAND AND 00/100 DOLLARS ($486,000.00)". Words and figures agree.
reasoning___InterestRatePercent: Section 2 fixes the rate at "four and three hundred seventy-five thousandths percent (4.375%) per annum".
reasoning___IsFirstLien: Section 9 warrants the property is free of prior encumbrances other than the taxes described in Schedule B, so this instrument takes first position.
reasoning___RecordingJurisdiction: The recording stamp on page 1 reads "OFFICIAL RECORDS OF MIAMI-DADE COUNTY, FLORIDA".
